description: Add independent PAM-service controls to both GNOME and KDE settings surfaces

gnome_changes.view_model: Added PendingPamToggle struct (id, display_name, enabled, high_impact) and pending_pam_toggle field to PresenterModel
gnome_changes.presenter: Added request_pam_toggle (stages risky enables, refuses unsupported), confirm_pam_toggle, cancel_pam_toggle; set_pam_service_enabled gains defence-in-depth unsupported guard
gnome_changes.fake: Expanded PAM service mock: gdm-password (Safe), sddm (Risky), sudo (Risky), su (Risky), polkit (Risky), systemd-user (Safe), fingerprint-auth (Unsupported); added is_pam_service_enabled test helper
gnome_changes.pam_services_component: Rewritten: gtk::Switch toggles, compatibility labels with warning/error CSS, unsupported switches greyed out (set_sensitive(false)), adw::MessageDialog for high-impact confirmation with HIGH_IMPACT_WARNING constant, Rc<RefCell<Presenter>> for callback mutation, keyboard-navigable (GTK default Tab/Space/Escape)
gnome_changes.wizard: Restructured to Rc<RefCell<ProfilePresenter>> for interactive callbacks; PAM section rendered separately via render_pam_services

kde_changes.main_qml: Added 'Authentication uses' section: Repeater over NamtorKcm.pamServices, QQC2.Switch per service, compatibility labels with color coding, unsupported switches disabled, high-impact confirmation QQC2.Dialog with highImpactWarning text
kde_changes.namtor_kcm_h: Added Q_INVOKABLE highImpactWarning() and Q_INVOKABLE isHighImpact(compatibility) methods
kde_changes.namtor_kcm_cpp: Implemented highImpactWarning() returning the regulatory warning text, isHighImpact() checking compatibility == 'risky'

high_impact_warning_text: FAR/FRR and real-attack PAD gates remain unmeasured. Enabling face authentication is experimental and not recommended for security-sensitive use.
